summary.text: Tim Godwin is the Libertarian Party nominee for Ohio House District 97 in the November 3, 2026 general election, running against incumbent Republican Adam Holmes and independent Kristine Geis.
He is a U.S. Marine Corps veteran.

paragraphs.text: Godwin served in the U.S. Marine Corps from 2001 to 2005, according to Ballotpedia.
In a Ballotpedia survey, he said he grew up in Central Ohio and later worked as a truck driver and then a mobile mechanic.

He listed accountability for elected officials and law enforcement, school choice with funding that follows the student, and abolishing or significantly reforming property taxes among his campaign messages.

sources.title: Tim Godwin, Ballotpedia Candidate Connection survey (2026)
